description.value: A commercial inn and full-service RV resort on the South Island Highway in Campbell River with ocean-view cottages and hookup sites; no tent camping is mentioned, and the resort is oriented toward longer stays rather than one-night cycle touring stops.

address.value: 170 South Island Highway, Campbell River B.C. V9W1A3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch succeeded and provides detailed amenity information. The contact page confirms a physical address (170 South Island Highway, Campbell River BC V9W1A3) and phone (250-203-0373) absent from OSM tags. The OSM name 'Driftwood by the Sea' is a shortened form of the website's full name 'Driftwood by the Sea Inn and RV Resort', which is flagged as a discrepancy. RV site amenities explicitly list City Water and Sewer, On-Site Laundry, and 30/50 amp electrical hookups; no cyclist-specific features are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name 'Driftwood by the Sea' is a shortened form; website uses full name 'Driftwood by the Sea Inn and RV Resort'
Full service RV sites listed as '*Now Full*' on the accommodations page — capacity may be limited or this reflects a long-term occupancy situation

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate year-round RV resort and inn on the South Island Highway in Campbell River, a key Vancouver Island cycling corridor. Touring cyclists can use the RV sites or cottages, and confirmed on-site laundry is a useful amenity for multi-day tours.
